title: AutoPrint invoice status overview and scheduled summaries

notes.text: Invoice search now shows a dated current AutoPrint outcome with expandable document-level details. Routine skips do not hide the last live print result; PrintNode errors and active correction holds remain visible.

Daily summary emails run at 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM Eastern to it@mintprintworks.com, covering the previous summary window and unresolved recent carryover. AutoPrint displays the schedule and recent delivery states.

Summaries start at the next scheduled slot after publication. Preview never sends them. Success describes accepted submission, not confirmed paper output; pending retries remain explicitly pending. No jobs are reprinted or changed by summaries.
Published Hub checks accepted PrintNode jobs from the last 14 days and alerts administrators about downstream errors, expiry, long delays, or repeated status-check failures.
Run-log documents show the latest PrintNode status and check time. Done means delivered to the computer’s print queue, not confirmed paper output. Monitoring never reprints or changes Printavo.
AutoPrint Recent Run Log now shows the latest 14 runs instead of 10, keeping earlier weekend attempts visible longer.

Failed invoice-discovery scans are labeled Discovery failed and explain why no individual retry is available. Eligible orders are checked again next cycle while AutoPrint is enabled; the original error remains visible.
Settings → General → Updates & Planned Features now provides an admin-only changelog and a searchable library of existing enhancement plans.
Read full planning documents inside Hub or download the original Markdown. Proposed ideas remain separate from approved work.
Publish the update to make this section available in the live Hub. Prepared labels are maintained release records, not automatic deployment detection.
Settings → Connections → Printavo lets administrators verify and save a replacement API token and record its expiration date.
Preview and published connection overrides are kept separate. Leaving the token blank retains the current token.
Credential rotation affects this Hub environment only, not other integrated platforms. Environment-based configuration expects PRINTAVO_API_TOKEN and PRINTAVO_API_EMAIL.
SepScope → Automation supports scheduled OUTPUT-file intake, held/skipped and failed details, and staff review before external actions.
Automation failure emails include a review link. Approved actions record inspection results in Printavo Production Notes and support Dropbox archiving.
Inspection checks were strengthened for localized missing underbase. Archive verification checks the Dropbox destination before removing the Printavo source file.
Dedicated plans preserve the discussions about Collection-based sales sheets, user activity reporting, and Google review requests with review monitoring and replies.
These documents are proposals, not enabled features or approval to activate tracking, send campaigns, or publish review replies.
